notablePrerequisites:
You have at least 11 life.
You control other lands that can tap for at least {3}{U}.
description:
Activate Beledros Witherbloom by paying 10 life.
In response to the activation, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} to copy the ability.
Resolve the copied ability, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Minamo's last ability by paying {U} ad tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate all other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
If your lands produce at least {3}{U}, this combo produces infinite mana.
